mapper.select: SELECT prod.*, category.name AS category_name, writer.code as writer_code, writer.id as writer_id, writer.path as writer_path, writer.ranking as writer_ranking, writer.rating as writer_rating, prod_img.target_code, prod_img.type, prod_img.path, ifnull(cnt_pick.cnt, 0) AS count_pick FROM MARKET_PRODUCT AS prod JOIN MARKET_CATEGORY AS category ON category.code = prod.cate_code JOIN ( SELECT m.code, m.id, profile_img.path, m.rating, m.ranking FROM MEMBER_ACCOUNT AS m LEFT JOIN IMAGES AS profile_img ON profile_img.target_code = m.code AND profile_img.type= 'profile' ) AS writer ON prod.mem_code = writer.code LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pick.prod_code, count(*) AS cnt FROM MARKET_PROD_PICK AS pick GROUP BY pick.prod_code ) AS cnt_pick ON cnt_pick.prod_code = prod.code LEFT JOIN IMAGES AS prod_img ON prod.code = prod_img.target_code AND prod_img.type = 'market' ORDER BY prod.created_at DESC
SELECT prod.*, category.name AS category_name FROM MARKET_PRODUCT AS prod JOIN MARKET_CATEGORY AS category ON prod.cate_code = category.code WHERE prod.code = #{code}
